Evaluates — repository mining: large-scale empirical study of 2,303 agent context files (RQ1 size/readability/structure, RQ2 maintenance, RQ3 instruction content, RQ4 automatic classification with GPT-5); extends the authors' prior study of 253 Claude.md files (PROFES 2025). Internal: manual classification bias (two inspectors, 80.3% agreement). Construct: binary presence labels ignore depth; FRE designed for prose, low correlation with human judgment; Markdown header syntax only. External: limited dataset, three agents. Gaps/future work: 'context debt' and context-file smells; ablation of structural elements on agent performance; co-evolution with code and CI linters; NFR blind spot (security, performance) and benchmarks testing NFR adherence; applying the classifier to commit histories
